Super weird experience here today.. my boyfriend and I brought in our 12 week old German Shepherd puppy in hopes of maybe getting her rabies vaccine. Everything started normal, we came in and weighed her & then went to the room. We were informed that she’s too young for rabies vaccine still but found out she needed her first round of boosters & wanted to get that done for her instead. Our puppy had a previous issue with her umbilical cord as well so we decided to ask while we were there as we noticed the vet checking out her incision either way. He informed us that he saw pus on it & asked me to come over and look at it & for some help restraining her. I felt confident doing so just because I’m a vet student with some experience in the field but I can’t imagine how someone else who doesn’t know would have reacted.. What I wasn’t prepared for was the vet to begin pressing on my puppy’s incision with his BARE hands. No tests, no nothing. He wasn’t even sure what the exact issue was & he just started draining her incision in a way I found to be very unsanitary as well as inconsiderate towards my little puppy. He then wanted to send her home with some antibiotics, again, without fully knowing what the issue was and after arguing with the technician about her weight, I felt very uncomfortable. He did not seem very educated & honestly neither did the tech. She had my poor puppy hanging off the table by her hind legs & then proceeded to place my puppy who isn’t fully vaccinated on the ground without any sort of consideration for her well being. My boyfriend and I left feeling mortified.

Side note:
They tried to get us to buy over the counter products from the store. Literally what is the point of bringing your pet here. Highly under qualified staff that just seemed interested in boosting sales for the company.

I will never come here again & I stand by my decision to leave mid appointment. I would have never expected my sweet girl’s first vet visit to be so unsettling and jarring.
Thankfully, she was unfazed & did well at the next clinic we took her to.

I've had nothing but an outstanding experience with the Petco Vetco Clinic for 2 of my pets now. From the moment scheduled online until  we walked in, the entire staff was welcoming, attentive, and genuinely compassionate. They made both my cat and me feel comfortable right away, which is no small feat since vet visits are usually pretty stressful.

A special thank you goes to Dee, the vet tech, who was wonderful. Dee was patient, engaging, and clearly cares deeply about the animals she works with. She took the time to answer questions honestly, explained everything clearly, and treated my cat with such kindness and respect needless to say, I think E. liked her too.

Dr. Yap Shing was equally exceptional. She was warm, knowledgeable, abd answered questions.I really appreciated how she took the time to discuss my cat's care in a straightforward and reassuring way. It's obvious that she truly has her patients' best interests at heart.

The clinic itself has a comfortable, welcoming atmosphere that made the entire visit feel much less intimidating than a typical veterinary office. Everyone on the team was friendly, engagin from start to finish.

On top of the excellent care, the pricing was very fair, and scheduling an appointment was incredib easy.

I highly recommend the Petco Vetco who islooking for a veterinary team that truly cares & really turns down stress level usually associated with vet visits.

Thanks again, everyone.
